name: Depths of the Cosmos
heroes: Blackstache, Scourge of the Pixel Seas
Argos, the Eye of the Cosmos

gist.Blackstache, Scourge of the Pixel Seas: Carries Terror at level two: a player's turn ends after six differently named cards and effects. His own side ignores Terror, and nothing you play can end its turn early.
gist.Argos, the Eye of the Cosmos: Gathers Change Counters according to the number of cards in YOUR hand and spends them to place a Cosmic Depths creature of exactly that level from hand or deck. Carries another Terror.
gist.Cooldin, King of Coolness: Plays The Cosmic Depths from the deck on the first turn.
gist.The Cosmic Depths: Area: once per turn a player may shuffle a hand card away to search and summon a creature of a level they do not control.
gist.Analyzer from the Cosmic Depths: Gains a Change Counter whenever you draw or search by an effect; spends counters to drop Invader Tokens into support zones, yours included. While a token is out, at the end of each of your turns you must discard a card or take a small hit on a target of the opponent's choice, unless you control a card with Change Counters.
gist.Gatherer from the Cosmic Depths: Gains a counter whenever you draw or search by an effect; turns counters into cards.
gist.Life-Searcher from the Cosmic Depths: Searches a Cosmic card on arrival and can swap itself for the next-bigger Cosmic creature from the deck.
gist.Invader from the Cosmic Depths: The top of the chain: places two more Invader Tokens (each a card or a small hit from you every turn) and discards spells for heavy hits.
gist.Gerrymander: Whenever one of your cards lets you choose, or says you "may", it decides for you.
gist.Cosmic Malfunction: Reaction: protects its Cosmic creatures from being moved or removed and locks the card you used for the turn.
gist.Deepsea Idol: Cancels a sweep on two or more creatures.
gist.Divine Gift of the Guardian: Once per game: its creatures take no damage for a turn.
gist.Alchemy: Ability: draws from its Potion Deck.
gist.Coffee: Clears statuses from a hero and gives it another action.

plan: This deck does not hurry; it feeds on what you do. Terror on Blackstache ends your turn after six differently named plays while his own side is exempt. Every card you draw or search by an effect puts a counter on the Analyzer and the Gatherer, the size of your hand puts counters on Argos, and the counters become cards, creatures placed for free (climbing level by level to the Invader) and Invader Tokens: a slow tax of one card or one small hit at the end of each of your turns, which only stops if you yourself control a card with Change Counters. Gerrymander makes your optional effects for you. A deck that reshuffles, tutors and draws potions every turn is its ideal opponent. All of it is three heroes' text and a set of small creatures: silence Blackstache or Argos, sweep the collectors before they are protected, and what remains is ordinary.

looks.early: The Cosmic Depths out on turn one, an Analyzer, your turn ending before you were finished.
looks.mid: Change Counters everywhere, a Gatherer and a Life-Searcher, Invader Tokens out, and you paying a card or a little health at the end of every turn.
looks.late: The Invader on the board, a full hand it never paid for, and your turns six plays long.

opening.tell: Your turn ended on its own after six differently named plays; the Terror sits on Blackstache.
opening.why: A frozen hero's Abilities are switched off: Snow Cannon on Blackstache gives you a full turn, and the Area that tutors its creatures can be removed; a normal setup turn of many small plays is exactly what Terror ends.

midgame.tell: An Analyzer and a Gatherer gain a counter every time you draw or search by an effect.
midgame.why: The collectors are small creatures and the whole engine; sweep them, and until then every Leadership and Magnetic Glove you play is paid to the other side.

crisis.tell: Invader Tokens are out and the Invader itself has arrived; at the end of each of your turns you lose a card or some health, and it does not, because its cards carry Change Counters.
crisis.why: The tax stops the moment you control a card with Change Counters: Dark Gear on its Analyzer or Gatherer (cheap, they are low level) ends it and takes a collector away in one play; otherwise The Yeeting removes a token. Setup turns just bleed.

endgame.tell: Blackstache is wounded; while he stands, Terror binds only you.
endgame.why: If Blackstache falls the limit applies to both sides, and its own long turns end early too; he is the hero to finish first.

opening.board: You attach, reshuffle, draw a potion, equip and play a glove; before you can cast, your turn is over.
